Container.Name: Ouicheur
Container.Overview: Self-hosted family wishlists with English and French interfaces, product imports, per-list coorganizers, revocable sessions, reservations, surprise protection and gift exchanges. Optional direct PayPal.Me contributions are declared, not verified payments. Visitors can use shared lists without accounts. First setup requires the private code from the container logs. Preview template: record final 1.2.0 installation and upgrade results before catalog submission.
Container.Requires: Linux amd64. Data and backup folders must be writable by UID 99 / GID 100. This image does not implement PUID/PGID variables.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Local HTTP port. Use an HTTPS reverse proxy for public access.

Config.Name: Application data
Config.Description: SQLite database, images and owner configuration. Keep on local storage and writable by 99:100. Preserve on upgrade.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Manual application backups. Writable by 99:100. Also export backups off this NAS.

Config.Name: Public origin (optional for direct LAN access)
Config.Description: For a reverse proxy, enter the exact HTTPS origin, without a trailing path. Leave empty for direct LAN access.

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: Keep 0 unless the trusted proxy replaces X-Forwarded-For and direct access is blocked.

Config.Name: Data directory
Config.Description: Internal data path; must match the data mount.
